findings.evidence: scripts/mros/population_git_trust.py:100-101 accepts a receipt when `git merge-base --is-ancestor freeze origin` succeeds. This accepts an origin commit descending from the freeze commit, including receipts created after the population was frozen. The R005 repair contract explicitly requires post-freeze receipt creation to fail closed.
findings.falsifier: Create the manifest in commit F, create a valid receipt in descendant commit R, and run load_exact_receipts with QUEUE_REF at R. The current implementation accepts the receipt instead of emitting a provenance error.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Require the receipt origin commit to be an ancestor of the manifest freeze commit, or verify the receipt path exists in the freeze commit tree; add a regression test for a newly created post-freeze receipt and an independently modified post-freeze receipt.
findings.requirement: Every receipt must be proven to exist at or before the frozen population manifest commit; post-freeze receipt creation must fail closed.

findings.evidence: scripts/mros/population_git_trust.py load_exact_receipts() accepts any JSON value from _show_json(); when the value is not a dictionary, it records REQUEST_INVALID but then unconditionally evaluates r.get('job'), causing AttributeError for arrays, strings, null, or scalars.
findings.falsifier: Add a test invoking load_exact_receipts() with a canonical receipt whose JSON root is [] or null; if it returns a structured error list rather than raising AttributeError, this finding is falsified.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Add an explicit root-object guard before all receipt field access, emit a typed RECEIPT_MEMBER_<i>_OBJECT_REQUIRED error, and add malformed-root regression tests. Do not alter acceptance, quorum, or runtime authority semantics.
findings.requirement: Malformed receipt JSON must be rejected through an explicit validation error without an uncaught exception.

findings.evidence: scripts/mros/program_context.py::validate_acceptance_trace validates only schema_version, sprint, candidate_head, authority/runtime/M9 labels, criterion status, and non-empty string evidence_refs. scripts/mros/advance_program.py::load_and_validate_context does not compare trace criterion IDs or evidence_refs with S003_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.json or load/hash the referenced evidence. authorize() separately loads only acceptance IDs from the frozen contract for audit coverage, so an attacker-controlled all-PASS acceptance trace with arbitrary criterion IDs/evidence_refs can pass context validation and remain part of the advancement input.
findings.falsifier: Provide a structurally valid acceptance trace for S003 with all criteria marked PASS but substitute criterion IDs and nonexistent or unrelated evidence_refs; authorization must reject it specifically for contract-ID and evidence-resolution/provenance mismatches.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Bind acceptance-trace criteria exactly to the frozen S003 acceptance contract, reject missing/extra/duplicate IDs, resolve each evidence_ref from an approved repository root, verify existence and immutable content identity, and fail closed on stale, nonexistent, or unrelated evidence.
findings.requirement: Advancement must validate the supplied acceptance trace against the frozen S003 acceptance contract and resolve or cryptographically verify every referenced evidence artifact.
